brief:
Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pursuing additional military confrontation ahead of Israeli elections, according to Al Jazeera English. Araghchi's accusation came as fighting intensified in Yemen amid broader regional tensions.

The charges reflect escalating rhetoric between Tehran and Jerusalem over recent months of military exchanges and threats of retaliation across the Middle East.
dek: US embassies in the Middle East have issued a security alert for Americans as fighting in Yemen continues to ramp up.
title: Iran accuses Netanyahu of seeking conflict before Israeli elections
